//==
// # Function graphs

// The graph of a hanging chain: y = Scale * cosh(x / Scale). Scale is the
// classic catenary constant a; the parameter is x, ranging over Domain
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catenary).
type Catenary2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Scale: Number;
    Domain: NumberInterval;
}
